paper_id: 2021_UbiComp_KATN Key Activity Detection via Inexact Supervised Learning
title: KATN: Key Activity Detection via Inexact Supervised Learning
venue: ACM Interact. Mob. Wearable Ubiquitous Technol.
motivation: IMU数据标注耗时耗力且准确标签难以获取，同时大量附带模糊信息的传感器数据严重未被利用
problem_framing: 利用粗粒度的用户交互事件(如点击按钮)作为模糊标签，从原始IMU数据中精确定位关键活动的起止时间
key_insight: 先训练粗粒度二分类深度模型，再用模型行为的注意力权重反推精确边界，而非直接学习精确标注
method_signature: Siamese双注意力网络(SAN)提取判别/细节双视角特征，结合时间重要性评分估计精确时段
evaluation_criteria: IoU、时间偏移误差、简单/复杂活动的检测准确率、用户适应后的性能提升
negative_result_or_admitted_limitations: 精确度受分类器前时序特征粒度限制
当前设计对多模态IMU数据融合效率不高
只能处理单个关键活动，多个相近活动需扩展
evidence_for_taste: training deep models to improve accuracy relies on specially collected and accurately labeled sensor data
IMU signals are much more difficult for humans to read and label directly
massive IMU data is being continuously generated in company with user interaction events
the click action may happen at any time in the last-mile delivery
leverage the inexact labels to train a two-class deep classifier
trace the positive outputs of the deep classifier through its algorithm
enabling the model to learn features with rotational invariance
restrains the activation of attention value by limiting the variance of attention values
make the network ignore what has learned and focus on learning the details
there still lacks an effective method to achieve accurate complex activity detection with only inexact labels
thinking_moves: 将精确边界检测问题转化为模型解释问题：训练粗粒度分类器后通过注意力权重反推精确时段
提出双视角注意力机制：判别注意力捕获最显著特征，详细注意力学习剩余部分，二者互补
借鉴多实例学习(MIL)范式处理模糊标签问题，通过袋级别标签监督实例级别检测
利用负样本方差约束防止注意力过度激活，增强模型判别能力
从工程失败案例反推领域需求：现有方法在复杂活动中表现差，需多视角设计
